o.text: Ultimately from Arabic ض م ن (ḍ m n, root); compare Ottoman Turkish تضمینات (tazmînât), Turkish tazminat (“compensation”).

From Persian شلوغ; likely ultimately from Arabic شُغْل (šuḡl), with the sense development 'work' → 'busy' → 'crowded, noisy' → 'mischievous, naughty'. The metathesis probably happened in Persian first.
